author: Praxis VI
title: Mechanistic probe: Praxis frozen (graph) + post-integration embedding whitening
abstract: Runs the frozen Praxis baseline (kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12,emb_k=17,γ_max=0.70,λ=0.605), then whitens X_emb in place (unit-std per PC; graph unchanged). Scores a principled test of embedding uniformity effects on the 10-metric panel.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run
from whiten_repca import whiten_embedding_inplace

CFG = dict(
    lam_override=0.605,
    delta=0.12,
    kdensity=22,
    k_total=50,
    emb_n_neighbors=17,
    gamma_max=0.70,
    cap=2.0,
    rng_seed=0
)

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # 1) Run frozen Praxis baseline
    B = _run(adata, **CFG)

    # 2) Mechanistic probe: whiten embedding (graph unchanged)
    stats = whiten_embedding_inplace(B, obsm_key="X_emb", center=False, eps=1e-8)
    print("WHITEN_STATS:", json.dumps(stats))

    return B
